input.quote: 11.2 Indemnification of AbbVie. Harpoon shall indemnify AbbVie, its Affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents (the "AbbVie Indemnitees"), and defend and save each of them harmless, from and against any and all Losses in connection with any and all Third Party Claims incurred by or rendered against the AbbVie Indemnitees arising from or occurring as a result of: [***]
input.rationale: Article 11 contains a mutual indemnity architecture that satisfies the structural preferred elements in our favour: Harpoon expressly indemnifies and defends AbbVie and its Affiliates against Third Party Claims (11.2), with prompt written notice (11.3), allocation of control of the defence including AbbVie's right to control where Harpoon does not assume it (11.4.1-11.4.2), and reasonable cooperation (11.4.4). Harpoon's indemnity is not subject to any aggregate or super-cap (11.5 limits only consequential damages), which is better than the fallback's 3x-annual-fees ceiling, so no cap should be added. However, the enumerated bases of both indemnities - the operative subclauses of 11.1 (our indemnity) and 11.2 (Harpoon's) - are redacted as "[***]". We therefore cannot confirm that Harpoon's indemnity reaches third-party IP infringement, Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law, a data breach caused by Harpoon, or Harpoon's gross negligence/wilful misconduct, nor that our own indemnity in 11.1 is confined to AbbVie-provided content and AbbVie's breach of law. Section 7.4 ("Subject to Section 11.2" for Third Party patent infringement claims against AbbVie) strongly implies that 11.2 covers third-party patent infringement, but that is inference, not text. Drafting an insertion blind would risk duplicating or conflicting with the redacted list, so we flag for review of the unredacted schedules rather than propose language now.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
mappings.quote: Harpoon shall indemnify AbbVie, its Affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents (the "AbbVie Indemnitees"), and defend and save each of them harmless

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
mappings.quote: from and against any and all Losses in connection with any and all Third Party Claims incurred by or rendered against the AbbVie Indemnitees

mappings.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
mappings.explanation: The list of covered bases in Section 11.2 is redacted ("[***]"). Section 7.4 makes third-party patent infringement claims against AbbVie "Subject to Section 11.2", which implies IP coverage, but the operative wording cannot be verified; confirm against the unredacted 11.2 before adding language that may duplicate it.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
mappings.explanation: Section 11.2's enumerated bases are redacted, so we cannot confirm whether Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law is included; requires review of the unredacted text.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
mappings.explanation: Section 11.2's enumerated bases are redacted; no unredacted provision elsewhere addresses Harpoon-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of AbbVie data.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
mappings.explanation: Section 11.2's enumerated bases are redacted. Section 11.5 carves fraud, wilful misconduct and gross negligence out of the consequential-damages exclusion, but that is a liability limitation, not an indemnity trigger.

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
mappings.quote: The Indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice (an "Indemnification Claim Notice") of any Losses or discovery of fact upon which such Indemnified Party intends to base a request for indemnification under this Article 11

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
mappings.quote: at its option, the indemnifying Party may assume the defense of any Third Party Claim by giving written notice to the Indemnified Party within [***] after the indemnifying Party's receipt of an Indemnification Claim Notice

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
mappings.quote: the Indemnified Party shall, and shall cause each indemnitee to, cooperate in the defense or prosecution thereof and shall furnish such records, information and testimony

mappings.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
